pp_account_b: Your name, email address, an optional phone number, and a hash of your password — never the password itself. Whatever you choose to put in your profile, packages and portfolio. The messages you send on a booking. If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address and profile picture from Google, and nothing else.
pp_account_h: What we collect when you have an account
pp_auto_b: For each session, the IP address and the browser user agent it was created from. These are kept so that you can see where your account is signed in and end a session you do not recognise, in your settings. There is no analytics package on this site, no advertising tracker and no third-party pixel of any kind.
pp_changes_b: We will post any change on this page and update the date above. If a change matters to you, we will say so rather than leaving you to spot it.
pp_children_b: This service is not for people under 18. If you believe a child has an account here, write to us and we will remove it.
pp_contact_b: Questions about privacy can go to {email}.
pp_cookies_b: Two. One keeps you signed in, and is HTTP-only so scripts on the page cannot read it. One remembers whether you are reading in English or Amharic. Neither is used to track you anywhere else, and there is nothing here to consent to beyond using the site.
pp_imported_b: You may have a profile here without ever having signed up. We compile creator listings from publicly available sources so that brands have a directory worth searching. What we hold in one of these is limited to what was already public: your name or working name, your handle, your public follower and engagement figures, your public profile picture, the platforms you post on, and the city and country you say you are in.
pp_imported_b2: We do not collect private messages, contact details that were not published, or anything behind a login. A profile compiled this way is marked Introduction only, carries no account, and nobody can act as you through it.
pp_imported_b3: You have three choices and all of them are free. You can claim the profile and take it over, in which case an operator checks by hand that it is really you. You can ask us to correct anything that is wrong. Or you can ask us to remove it entirely, and we will. Write to {email}.
pp_intro: This explains what we hold about you, why, and what you can do about it.
pp_masking_b: Email addresses, phone numbers and messaging handles are stripped out of booking messages before the message is stored, not after. The unmasked text is never written down. This keeps deals on the platform, and it also means a message thread is not a place where your phone number quietly accumulates.
pp_retention_b: Profile content stays until you remove it or ask us to. Deals, and the audit log of who changed what, are kept as business records after an account closes: they record obligations between two parties, so they are not ours alone to erase. The audit log is append-only by design — entries are never edited or deleted, which is what makes it worth anything in a dispute.
pp_rights_b: See and correct your details in your settings. Ask us to close your account from the same page. Ask us to remove a profile we compiled before you joined. Ask for a copy of what we hold about you, or object to something we are doing with it, by writing to {email}. We will answer within thirty days.
pp_security_b: Passwords are hashed, never stored in a readable form. Session cookies are HTTP-only and only sent over HTTPS. You can end any session from your settings. Uploaded files are stored outside the web root and served through the application, so nothing is reachable by guessing a URL. No system is perfect, and we will tell you without delay if something happens that affects you.
pp_share_b: The other side of a deal sees your name, your profile and your messages on it. Operators see what they need in order to work a queue — a verification, a claim, a disputed booking — and every such decision is written to an audit log with their name on it. Our hosting provider stores the data on our behalf. We do not sell personal data, and we do not share it for anyone else's marketing.
pp_use_b: Running the marketplace: showing your profile to brands, carrying a deal through its stages, delivering the notifications you have asked for, preventing abuse and impersonation, and keeping records of what was agreed. We do not make decisions about you by automated means that carry a legal effect.
pp_who_b: {name} operates this marketplace and is responsible for the personal data described here. You can reach us at {email}.

srv_terms_already_agreed: Terms are already agreed — they cannot be renegotiated.
srv_upload_bad_type: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF images and PDFs can be uploaded
srv_upload_too_large: That file is too large — uploads are limited to 8 MB
theme_appearance_note: Choose how the site looks. System follows your device.
tos_accounts_b: Give accurate details and keep them current. You are responsible for what happens under your account, so tell us at once if you think somebody else has access to it. An account holds one role — creator, brand or operator — and a creator account holds one public profile.
tos_badges_b: A verification badge means we checked identity evidence or public proof of control over an account at a point in time. It is not an endorsement, and it is not a guarantee of anyone's conduct or results. Trending is computed from activity on the site; featured placement is an editorial choice. Neither is for sale.
tos_changes_b: We will post any change on this page and update the date above. Continuing to use the service after a change means you accept it.
tos_closure_b: We may suspend or close an account that breaches these terms. You can ask us to close your account from your settings; an operator handles it by hand. Records of deals already agreed are kept, because they record obligations between two parties and are not ours alone to erase.
tos_contact_b: Questions about these terms can go to {email}.
tos_content_b: Creators keep ownership of the work they make. Whatever licence a brand receives is the one the deal specifies, and nothing here grants a brand more than that. By uploading a picture, a portfolio piece or any other material to your profile, you grant us a non-exclusive licence to display it on this site for as long as the profile is here, and you confirm you have the right to do so.
tos_deals_b: A deal moves through declared states from proposal to completion, and the terms are frozen at the moment both sides accept a proposal. That frozen record is what we will refer to if either side later disagrees about what was agreed. The agreement itself is between the brand and the creator; obligations under it are theirs, not ours.
tos_disputes_b: Try to settle it with the other side first. Either party can mark a deal disputed, and an operator will look at the record — the frozen terms, the messages, what was delivered and when. That is a review of the record, not arbitration of the underlying agreement, and it does not make us responsible for either side's obligations.
tos_fees_b: We charge a platform fee of {fee}% of the agreed price. Every deal shows the fee and the resulting creator payout before either side accepts it, so the number is never a surprise. We will give notice here before changing the rate, and a change does not alter a deal whose terms are already frozen.
tos_intro: These terms govern your use of this marketplace. By creating an account or opening a deal through it, you accept them.
tos_law_b: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, and the courts of Addis Ababa have jurisdiction.
tos_liability_b: The service is provided as it is. We do not promise it will be uninterrupted, and we do not promise any particular outcome from a collaboration arranged through it. To the extent the law allows, our liability to you is limited to the fees you have paid us in the twelve months before the claim. Nothing here excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.
tos_liability_h: What we do and do not promise
tos_listed_b: Some creator profiles here are compiled from publicly available information before the creator has an account. They are marked Introduction only and nobody is behind them. If such a profile describes you, you can claim it from the profile page or from your dashboard; an operator checks each claim by hand before handing anything over.
tos_listed_b2: If you would rather the profile were not here at all, ask and we will remove it. A brand may open a deal against an unclaimed profile; that is a lead we undertake to pass on, not an agreement the creator has made, and it binds nobody until they have an account and accept it.
tos_listed_h: Profiles we listed before you joined
tos_offplatform_b: Contact details in booking messages are masked automatically. Finding somebody here and then moving the deal elsewhere to avoid the fee is a breach of these terms, and we may suspend an account that does it.
tos_offplatform_h: Taking a deal off the platform
tos_payment_b: We do not process payments at present. Where a deal shows compensation as held, that is a record an operator entered after confirming an arrangement made directly between the two sides — it does not mean we are holding funds. Until a payment provider is connected, money does not move through this platform, and the escrow status is bookkeeping rather than custody. We will update these terms before that changes.
tos_use_b: Do not impersonate anyone, claim a profile that is not yours, misstate audience figures, upload anything you have no right to, scrape the directory, or access the service by automated means without our written agreement.
tos_what_b: Creator Network is a marketplace where organisations and content creators find one another and agree collaborations. We provide the directory, the negotiation record, the delivery record and the review. We are not a party to any collaboration agreed through it. We do not employ creators, and we do not act as anyone's agent.
up_click_or_drag: Click to upload or drag and drop

val_claim_evidence: Say a bit more — an operator has to be able to check it.
val_description_min: Give creators something to respond to
val_full_url: Enter a full URL starting with http

val_image_required: Choose an image for the slide

val_paid_needs_budget: A published paid campaign needs a budget
val_password_unchanged: That is the password you already have
val_pitch_min: Say why your audience fits, in a sentence or three
val_slug_format: Lower-case letters, numbers and dashes only
verif_cn_title: Identity documents and channel ownership both checked by an operator
verif_id_title: Government identity document checked by an operator
vf_badge_note: Your badge appears on your public profile and in discovery filters. An operator reviews every case by hand.
vf_case_open_body: An operator is reviewing your evidence. You will see the outcome here, with a note explaining the decision either way.
vf_description: Badges name the evidence that was actually checked — there is no generic “verified” tick, because it would not tell a brand anything.
vf_evidence_placeholder: Government ID or registration certificate (PDF or image)
vf_nothing_body: Create your creator profile or register an organisation first.
vf_privacy_note: Identity documents are visible only to operators reviewing your case, and are never shown on your public profile.
err_unexpected: Something went wrong on our side.
err_body_404: That link does not lead anywhere. It may have been moved or removed.
err_body_403: Your account does not have access to this page.
err_body_generic: We could not finish that. Trying again often works; if it does not, the reference below will help us find it.
srv_upload_content_mismatch: That file is not the kind of image it claims to be. Re-save it and try again.
mail_reset_body: Someone asked to reset the password on your account. Choose a new one with the button below.
mail_reset_footnote: The link works for one hour, and once only. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message — nothing changes until a new password is set.
mail_verify_body: Confirm this address so we can reach you about your bookings, and so you can get back in if you ever lose your password.
mail_verify_footnote: The link works for one day. If you did not create an account, you can ignore this message.
mail_prefs_footnote: You are getting this because of your notification settings. Change what reaches you under Settings.
fp_subtitle: Type the address you signed up with and we will send a link for setting a new password.
fp_sent_body: If {email} is on file, a link for setting a new password is on its way. It works for one hour.
rp_subtitle: Pick something you have not used here before. You will be signed in once it is saved.
rp_invalid_body: Reset links work for one hour, and once only. Ask for a fresh one and it will arrive in a moment.
ve_ok_body: Thank you — we can reach you now, and you can get back in if you ever lose your password.
ve_bad_body: Confirmation links work for one day, and once only. Send yourself a fresh one from your settings.
set_verify_sent: Confirmation link sent — check your inbox.
set_verify_failed: We could not send the confirmation link. Try again in a moment.
srv_reset_failed: We could not send the link. Try again in a moment.
srv_reset_invalid: That link has expired, or it has already been used.
mail_pwreset_done_body: The password on your account has just been reset, and every device that was signed in has been signed out.
mail_pwreset_done_footnote: If this was not you, ask for a new reset link straight away — whoever did it is signed out too, and the address on the account is still yours.
login_reset_done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.
